types.name: Grid
types.description: High-intensity interval training on a grid of stations: short, hard work intervals with short rests, using your bodyweight and kit like kettlebells, dumbbells and slam balls. Full body, and every fitness level can join.

types.name: Lift Club
types.description: A strength class built around the big lifts: squats, deadlifts, presses and rows with barbells, dumbbells and kettlebells. The focus is good technique and lifting a little heavier over time.

types.name: Hyrox
types.description: Training for Hyrox fitness racing: running mixed with the race stations, such as the SkiErg, sled push and pull, burpee broad jumps, rowing, farmer's carry, sandbag lunges and wall balls.

types.name: Rumble
types.description: A boxing-style cardio class: punch combinations and footwork to music, mixed with conditioning and core work.

types.name: Shape
types.description: A toning and conditioning class: lighter weights, higher reps and plenty of core work to build muscular endurance.

types.name: Pump
types.description: A barbell class to music: light to moderate weights and high reps that work every major muscle group.
